title: Charles E. "Chuck" Dederich
excerpt: Editorial research draft about Chuck Dederich (1913-1997), founder of Synanon, whose confrontation method "the Game" became the template for attack therapy in teen programs. Lineage claims require program-by-program sources.

person_notable_work: Created "the Game," the confrontation method copied by teen programs
Pleaded no contest in 1980 to conspiracy in the rattlesnake attack on lawyer Paul Morantz
